thread:
Alex R: quick sync — last step before we mark the new "cobalt-mini" model as 'serving-ready'. can people drop quick checks for weights/tokenizer/config/tool-calls? :eyes:
Maria T: weights are uploaded to s3://rw-models/cobalt-mini/v1/weights.tar.gz — checksum matches. I ran `sha256sum` and compared to the release note.
Jin H: tokenizer: we noticed rare split on non-breaking space ( ) in the training tokenization. small patch in tokenizer mapping fixes it. added a unit test in `tokenizer_test.py` — passes locally.
Kevin L: config validation: ran `python infra/validate_model_config.py --path models/cobalt-mini/config.yaml`. validator returned 1 warning (missing recommended `preferred_kv_cache_size`) but no blocking errors. I pushed a default into the config: `preferred_kv_cache_size: 2G` as a safe fallback.
Alex R: nice. can we run the golden prompts/regression eval quickly? want to ensure structured outputs (json schemas) and tool calling don't regress.
Maria T: kicked off the eval harness on the new model — job id `eval-2026-03-15-44`. Quick summary: 92% pass on base generation. structured-output tests: 7 fails (mostly missing required `meta.version` field).
Jin H: likely from the response wrapper layer — model returned plain text in a few cases, our postprocessor didn't detect the delim markers. added a stricter check for top-level object and fallback prompt to enforce `{"meta":{}}` presence. will re-run.
Kevin L: tool calling smoke: I tried the sample `weather` tool call from the golden suite. The function signature schema in `tools/registry.json` expected `location: string`, but the model emitted `location: {city: 'sf'}` nested object. failing schema validation.
Maria T: ah that matches one of the tokenizer edge cases where punctuation gets glued to tokens, model hallucinated a nested object. Jin — could the prompt instruct a flat param structure? e.g., `Return a flat JSON with keys: location, date`
Jin H: yes — will update the tool-calling prompt template in `golden/prompts/toolcall.json` to include an explicit example. also adding a test case where model returns nested vs flat to assert failure mode.
deploy-bot: CI: eval-harness/eval-2026-03-15-44: COMPLETED (partial failures). link: https://ci.rw/eval/2026/44 :warning:
Alex R: thanks. items: 1) jin to push prompt update + re-run structured-output tests; 2) kevin to update registry schema OR add a transformer to coerce nested->flat for `location`; 3) maria to re-run full eval and post final pass rate. aim to close by EOD Pacific. :100:
Maria T: will re-run once jin's prompt fix is in. scheduled re-run at 15:20 PT.
Kevin L: I'll add a note in the release checklist under 'tool-calls' to check for param shapes. If we need quick patch, I'll add a coercion layer in serving to avoid immediate rollback.
Jin H: pushed prompt tweak in PR #2107 (tests added). running local golden-suite now. partial green, structured-output now 99% — 1 flaky case left (date parsing).
Alex R: awesome — who owns the flaky date parse?
Maria T: I'll take it — probably the parser expecting ISO8601 vs the model returning `Mar 15`. will add normalization in postprocessor and a small gold test.
Kevin L: deploy-bot shows a scheduled canary deploy window tonight 02:00 UTC. should we wait for full green?
Alex R: yes — hold canary until we confirm eval passes and tool-call smoke is fixed. add a note in the canary ticket.
Maria T: re-run finished: eval-2026-03-15-44-retry -> PASS 98.6% overall; structured-output now 100% after parser normalization. posted results to the eval dashboard.
Jin H: golden-suite toolcall smoke: all sample tools pass now. updated docs with one-line prompt guidance for tool authors. PR #2107 merged.
Kevin L: I'll remove the temporary coercion layer from serving once we verify canary. leaving the release checklist updated.
Alex R: perfect. I'm marking this thread as status: go/no-go -> PENDING until canary window. thanks everyone. :pray:
Maria T: tagging ops in the canary ticket, and adding rollback steps.
Alex R: ping me after canary start; I'll watch logs and perf.
deploy-bot: Canary schedule: ticket RW-1123, window 2026-03-16T02:00:00Z -> 2026-03-16T03:00:00Z :spiral_calendar:
Alex R: copy. if anything odd, :alarm_clock: escalate to eng-oncall.
